options.content:
### 🐳 Docker - Container Overview

Per-container drill-down showing CPU, memory, network, disk, and resource pressure for a single Docker container.

panels.description: Shows if metrics are being received for the selected time range.

targets.expr: vector(1) and on() ((count(up{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"} == 1) > 0) and (absent(absent(machine_scrape_error{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"})))) or vector(0) and on() ((count(up{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"}) > 0) and (absent(machine_scrape_error{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"})))

panels.title: Metrics

panels.description: cAdvisor version running on this host.
panels.title: cAdvisor Version

panels.description: Shows the timestamp of the latest metrics received for this integration in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: vector(1) and on() ((count(up{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"} == 1) > 0) and (absent(absent(machine_scrape_error{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"})))) or vector(0) and on() ((count(up{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"}) > 0) and (absent(machine_scrape_error{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job"})))

panels.title: Latest metrics received

panels.description: cAdvisor build metadata.
panels.title: cAdvisor Build Info

panels.description: Shows the installed version of this integration.
panels.title: Integration version

panels.description: 1 if cAdvisor had errors collecting host metrics.
panels.title: Scrape Errors

panels.description: The Docker image name and tag used to create this container.
panels.title: Image

panels.description: The timestamp when this container was started.
panels.title: Start Time

panels.description: The most recent time a metric was received from this container.
panels.title: Last Seen

panels.description: Result of the container's Docker HEALTHCHECK. Only populated for containers that define a health check.
panels.title: Health State

panels.description: Docker labels attached to this container, sourced from container_last_seen metric labels.
Static resource limits configured on this container.
panels.title: Resource Limits

panels.description: Instant CPU usage percentage for the selected container.
panels.title: CPU Usage (now)

panels.description: Breakdown of CPU time in user space vs kernel space. High Kernel% suggests syscall-heavy or I/O-heavy workload.
panels.title: CPU Usage — User / System

panels.description: Non-reclaimable memory. This is what the OOM killer acts on.
panels.title: Working Set

panels.description: Working set = RSS + non-reclaimable cache. Page cache is normal to be high — it can be reclaimed under pressure.
panels.title: Memory Breakdown

panels.description: Container swap usage. Non-zero values indicate the container has exceeded its RAM budget.
panels.title: Swap Usage

panels.description: OOM kills in the selected time range. Any kill means a process was forcibly terminated due to memory exhaustion.
panels.title: OOM Events

panels.description: Rate of OOM kill events over time.
panels.title: OOM Rate

panels.description: Bytes received and transmitted per second.
panels.title: Network Traffic

panels.description: Rate of dropped packets and errors. Sustained drops indicate network saturation or misconfiguration.
panels.title: Network errors and drops

panels.description: Bytes consumed by this container on its writable filesystem layer.
panels.title: Disk usage

panels.description: Read and write throughput in bytes per second.
panels.title: Disk I/O

panels.description: Used bytes as a percentage of the filesystem limit. Values near 100% will cause write failures.

targets.expr: container_fs_usage_bytes{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job", instance="$instance", name="$name"} / (container_fs_limit_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance", name="$name"} > 0)

panels.title: Filesystem Utilisation

panels.description: Used inodes as a percentage of total. Inode exhaustion causes 'no space left' errors even when disk bytes are available.

targets.expr: (container_fs_inodes_total{asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job", instance="$instance", name="$name"} - container_fs_inodes_free{job="$job", instance="$instance", name="$name"}) / container_fs_inodes_total{job="$job", instance="$instance", name="$name"}

panels.title: Inode Utilisation

panels.description: % of time tasks waited for (Waiting) or were completely blocked by (Stalled) CPU. Stalled > 0 = severe CPU starvation.
panels.title: CPU Pressure

panels.description: % of time tasks waited on or were stalled by I/O. Sustained stalled values = disk bottleneck.
panels.title: I/O Pressure

panels.description: % of time tasks were waiting for or completely blocked by memory reclaim. Any stalled time is an OOM precursor.
panels.title: Memory Pressure
